noah: Heads-up from a customer demo: Console 'Run as SA' sometimes loses the project affinity and charges the SA owner org. Quick repro below.
noah: Repro: Console -> Run snippet -> Run as: sa-ml@acme -> choose project=proj-ml -> execute -> quota increments on org-acme.
noah: Ingress headers we captured: `Authorization: Bearer ...; X-Run-As-SA: sa-ml; X-Console-Affinity: proj-ml; X-Org: org-acme`
tess: Router trace: `[2026-04-18T09:05:01Z] req=req_0xabc claims={"sa":"sa-ml","effective_project":null,"org":"org-acme"} decision=charge_target=org-acme reason=no_effective_project`
li: Quick guess: API gateway strips `X-Console-Affinity` for the impersonation route due to header hygiene. We tightened that for security.
noah: Customer impact is small but visible. Billing asked for detection query and a short remediation plan.
billing-bot: alert: small anomaly detected 2026-04-18T09:00Z correlated with impersonation flows. Please add telemetry.
tess: Proposed fixes: (1) Short-term: whitelist `X-Console-Affinity` for impersonation route behind flag `authz:console-affinity-hotfix`. (2) Long-term: have key-mint service embed `affinity_project` into short-lived token at mint after validating membership. Router will prefer token claim. Also add quota telemetry field `billing_affinity_source` with enum {token_claim, header, sa_owner}.
li: Also add a tiny console banner when chosen SA lacks default project: "Requests may be billed to org-acme unless you set a project for this SA". Saves support churn.
ops-bot: deploy: gateway canary v2.21 tonight. Gate: authz:console-affinity-hotfix.
tess: I'll open PRs for gateway whitelist and telemetry. ETA reviews: 2h. Will post detection query for billing in this thread.
noah: Thanks 609
